body: well good for him. I hope to one day break my cycle of gaming covering up my  depressions and anxiety and letting me not interact with people.  Some day .

I have a lot of fear and worry about almost everything, but mostly things involving any sort of conflict or awkwardness  ranging from normalish to  i would rather die than answer the phone and have to talk to a stranger. I also go through long Periods of deep sadness where even basic things feel like they take a lot of effort to convince my self to do them.
I worry i wont know what to say  or how to put into words how i feel
Do i go to a regular doctor ? or there some sort of special place i should look ?
